აქამდე ჩვენი endpoint-ები პასუხს მთლიანა: Until now our endpoints returned the answer whole: the user stared at an empty screen for 2–8 seconds. Every modern AI chat shows the answer as it's being written. Today we get the answer from Gemini in pieces, send it to the client right away with Server-Sent Events, and add cancellation — so we don't pay for Gemini's tokens after the user has left. Without this skill an AI chat doesn't look like a product.
